title: 천 번째 삭제
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. A clean electric guitar plays a jazz-influenced progression with seventh chords and subtle vibrato. A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the guitar. The drums consist of a soft, dry kick on beats 1 and 3, with a crisp rimshot on 2 and 4, and a steady 16th-note hi-hat pattern. A female vocalist delivers breathy, intimate verses in a mid-range register, transitioning to a more melodic, slightly higher register in the pre-chorus. The production is minimal with light plate reverb on the vocals. Key of E Major, 85 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar with light chorus, soft sub-bass]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
커튼 사이로 비친 들어 [kick drum and rimshot enter]
일요일 오후의 온기야
침대 위에 누워서 폰을 들어
쇼츠를 넘겨 [16th-note hi-hats enter]
찍고 지우고 또 찍어
각도를 바꿔 또 찍어
백장째 같은 얼굴 맘에 안 드는 거야

[Pre-Chorus]
거울 속 나는 왜 화면이랑 달라
누구를 위한 건지 모르겠어
전부 제 삭제 [vocal harmony on '삭제']
